earnings.title: CVS HEALTH CORPORATION REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS
highlights: Third quarter total revenues increased to $108.4 billion, up 5.4% year-over-year
Third quarter GAAP diluted EPS of $1.68 and Adjusted EPS of $2.09

Third quarter GAAP diluted earnings per share of $1.68 increased from a loss per share of $3.13 in the prior year, reflecting the absence of a $5.7 billion goodwill impairment charge recorded in the third quarter of 2025.

Adjusted EPS of $2.09 increased from $1.60 in the prior year, primarily due to improved adjusted operating income in the Health Care Benefits segment, reflecting continued execution of its margin recovery plan.
Total revenues increased 5.4% primarily driven by growth in the Health Services and Health Care Benefits segments.
outlook: GAAP diluted EPS guidance to at least $6.98 from a range of $6.84 to $7.04
Adjusted EPS guidance to at least $8.20 from a range of $7.90 to $8.10
Cash flow from operations guidance to at least $15.5 billion from at least $11.5 billion

items.heading: We may not be able to accurately forecast health care and other benefit costs, including as a result of pandemics or disease outbreaks, which could adversely affect our Health Care Benefits segment’s operating results. There can be no assurance that future health care and other benefit costs will not exceed our projections.
Adverse economic conditions in the U.S. and abroad can materially and adversely impact our businesses, operating results, cash flows and financial condition.
Each of our segments operates in a highly competitive and evolving business environment; and operating income in the industries in which we compete may decline.
A change in our Health Care Benefits product mix may adversely affect our profit margins.
Our Health Care Delivery businesses face unique risks.
Negative public perception of the industries in which we operate, or of our industries’ or our practices, can adversely affect our businesses, operating results, cash flows and prospects.
